cost_definition: Nested Ns share calls; logical calls include retries/cache reuse. Request latency is not allocated GPU time. Bind homogeneous timings separately.

evidence_replacement.note: Selected-sample exploratory diagnostic, not a new system TPR or independently verified evidence study.

evidence_retention.note: Coverage is conditional on unverified model reference interpretations. Quotation containment applies only to EaE. Citation omission is not proof of misunderstanding.
